channel.title: foidslop recipes
channel.description: Daily recipes made for one from foidslop.

item.title: Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Earthy roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and candied walnuts. Classic bistro salad.

item.title: Smoked Oyster Toast
item.description: A tin of smoked oysters on buttered rye toast with hot sauce. Deeply underrated girl dinner.

item.title: Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp
item.description: Shrimp cooked in 5 minutes in a sticky honey garlic butter. Eat with bread or rice.

item.title: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine
item.description: A proper small board built for one, with wine. This is aspirational solo dining.

item.title: Mango with Tajin and Lime
item.description: Sweet ripe mango sliced and dusted with Tajin and lime. The refreshing solo dessert dinner.

item.title: Creamed Spinach on Toast
item.description: Classic steakhouse creamed spinach reduced down to a solo toast topping. Rich and ridiculous.

item.title: Overnight Oats as Dinner
item.description: The reverse breakfast dinner. Prepared oats with toppings eaten at any hour.

item.title: Takis with Chamoy and Lime
item.description: Hot chips drizzled with chamoy and lime. The chaotic snack dinner that TikTok loves.

item.title: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice
item.description: Sushi grade tuna, sesame spiced and piled onto shatteringly crispy pan fried rice cakes.

item.title: Roasted Tomato and Burrata Toast
item.description: Slow roasted sweet tomatoes with creamy burrata on grilled bread. The best toast.

item.title: Silky Egg Drop Soup
item.description: Better than takeout. Silky egg ribbons in a gingery, savory broth.

item.title: Creamy Tuscan White Beans
item.description: Butter beans simmered in garlic, tomatoes, and spinach. Italian pantry perfection.

item.title: Warm Olives with Orange and Herbs
item.description: Olives gently warmed in olive oil with citrus and herbs. A 5 minute pot of wonder.

item.title: Pita Pizza
item.description: A 10 minute pizza using pita bread as the base. Crispy, melty, endlessly customizable.

item.title: Blistered Padron Peppers
item.description: Fried green Spanish peppers with flaky salt. Most are mild, some are brutally hot.

item.title: Pan Con Tomate
item.description: The Catalan classic. Ripe tomato rubbed directly onto garlicky toasted bread.

item.title: 10-Minute Freezer Fried Rice
item.description: Using entirely freezer ingredients. Frozen rice, vegetables, egg. Dinner in 10 minutes flat.

item.title: Seasonal Fruit and Cheese Plate
item.description: Seasonal fruit with a few good cheeses. The no effort elegant dinner.

item.title: Crispy Fried Rice
item.description: Day old rice fried until crispy with soy, egg, and sesame. The solo dinner staple.

item.title: Creamy Mushroom Toast with Thyme
item.description: Sauteed mushrooms in garlic and thyme, splashed with cream, on thick buttered toast.

item.title: Everything Bagel Salmon Bites
item.description: All the vibes of a bagel and lox without the bagel. Refreshing, salty, quick.

item.title: Carbonara for One
item.description: True carbonara. No cream, just eggs, guanciale, and pecorino. Perfect.

item.title: Stuffed Bell Pepper with Rice and Feta
item.description: Two halves of roasted bell pepper filled with herby rice and feta. Easy solo dinner.

item.title: Anchovy Butter Toast
item.description: For the umami obsessed. Anchovies mashed into butter on very good toast.

item.title: Prosciutto and Fig Toast
item.description: Salty cured meat and sweet figs on ricotta toast. A two minute fancy moment.

item.title: Homemade Crunchwrap
item.description: Flour tortilla folded around all the Taco Bell fixings. The ultimate comfort DIY.

item.title: Pasta e Fagioli
item.description: Italian peasant soup. Pasta and white beans in a rich tomato rosemary broth.

item.title: Labneh with Za'atar and Olive Oil
item.description: Strained yogurt cheese with za'atar and olive oil. The Middle Eastern answer to cream cheese.

item.title: Frittata for One
item.description: Open face Italian omelette with whatever is in the fridge. Elegant and effortless.

item.title: Stracciatella with Olive Oil and Grilled Bread
item.description: Creamy stracciatella drizzled with olive oil and black pepper. The simplest luxury.

item.title: 4th of July Burrata Plate
item.description: Red, white, and blue on a plate. Creamy burrata, sweet strawberries, and blueberries for a festive, no cook girl dinner.

item.title: Egg Yolk Garlic Pasta
item.description: Garlic pasta finished with an egg yolk. A solo carbonara for when you cannot be bothered.

item.title: White Bean Dip with Lemon and Rosemary
item.description: Blended white beans with olive oil and lemon. A more interesting alternative to hummus.

item.title: Matcha Latte and Banana with Peanut Butter
item.description: The girl dinner that is just a drink and a banana with nut butter. Deeply valid.

item.title: Panzanella
item.description: Tuscan bread salad. Stale bread soaked in the juices of very ripe tomatoes.

item.title: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl
item.description: Cottage cheese topped with cucumber, tomatoes, everything seasoning, and chilli crisp makes a savory bowl in five minutes.

item.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
item.description: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil, chilli, and parsley. Italian simplicity at its finest.

item.title: Caramelized Onion Dip with Ridged Chips
item.description: Caramelized onion dip made from scratch. Vastly superior to the packet kind.

item.title: Loaded Sweet Potato with Black Beans
item.description: Baked sweet potato with black beans, avocado, and lime crema. A whole satisfying meal.

item.title: Hot Honey Butter Toast
item.description: The most minimal toast possible. Just good bread, real butter, and hot honey.

item.title: Miso Soup with Tofu and Noodles
item.description: Warm, savory, deeply comforting. A proper miso broth with noodles and soft tofu.

item.title: Sheet Pan Nachos
item.description: Maximum chip to topping ratio achieved by spreading everything on one tray.

item.title: Medjool Dates with Almond Butter and Flaky Salt
item.description: Nature's candy stuffed with almond butter. The sweet salty snack that feels indulgent.

item.title: Kimchi Butter Ramen
item.description: Shin Ramyun with kimchi, butter, and a soft egg. The Korean midnight snack elevated.

item.title: Avocado and Egg Salad Lettuce Cups
item.description: Creamy mashed avocado and chopped egg in crisp lettuce. Fresh, filling, no bread needed.

item.title: Tinned Fish Board
item.description: The elevated pantry dinner. Sardines, smoked oysters, arranged on a board with all the accompaniments.

item.title: Cacio e Pepe
item.description: Only three ingredients but requires technique. Cheese, pepper, and pasta water do everything.

item.title: Shakshuka for One
item.description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce. A dramatic, satisfying pan dinner.

item.title: Goat Cheese Toast with Honey and Walnuts
item.description: Tangy goat cheese on toasted bread with honey. Easy, satisfying, and kind of impressive.

item.title: Tuna Salad on Crackers
item.description: A proper tuna salad. Mayo, celery, dijon, capers. Scooped onto crackers.

item.title: Elevated Canned Tomato Soup
item.description: Good canned tomato bisque made significantly better with cream, butter, and basil oil.

item.title: Edamame with Garlic Butter and Chilli
item.description: Steamed edamame tossed with garlic butter and chilli makes a salty, hands-on snack dinner.

item.title: Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta
item.description: Fresh blistered tomato sauce with torn mozzarella that melts into hot pasta. Summer simplicity.

item.title: Garlic Parmesan Toast
item.description: The simplest, most satisfying thing. Crispy garlic toast with melted parmesan.

item.title: Adult Lunchable Plate
item.description: Exactly what you think. Crackers, deli meat, cheese, grapes, a little candy if you want.

item.title: Lox Plate on Cucumber
item.description: Smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers, and cucumber deliver all the familiar lox flavors without a bagel.

item.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips
item.description: Warm, cheesy, bubbly dip made in 20 minutes. The shareable girl dinner.

item.title: Prosciutto and Melon
item.description: The Italian classic that needs no recipe. Sweet cantaloupe and salty prosciutto.

item.title: Cold Sesame Noodles
item.description: Room temperature noodles in a nutty, gingery sauce. Better cold than hot.

item.title: Sleepy Girl Mocktail
item.description: Tart cherry juice and sparkling water make a bright, fizzy mocktail with an optional magnesium addition.

item.title: Guacamole and Tortilla Chips
item.description: Homemade guacamole in five minutes. Because you deserve better than the tub.

item.title: Peanut Butter Sesame Noodles
item.description: Sesame peanut sauce over noodles. The most satisfying thing you can make in 15 minutes.

item.title: Crispy Spiced Chickpea and Feta Bowl
item.description: Crispy spiced chickpeas over lemony yogurt with feta and herbs. Deeply satisfying.

item.title: Cucumber Cream Cheese Bites
item.description: Refreshing, crunchy little bites. A snack that feels like an appetizer.

item.title: Classic Cheese Quesadilla
item.description: The comfort food that requires no recipe. Just cheese, a tortilla, and heat.

item.title: Brown Butter Gnocchi with Sage
item.description: Pillowy store bought gnocchi in nutty brown butter with crispy sage. Ready in 10 minutes.

item.title: Antipasto Plate
item.description: Italian store bought excellence arranged beautifully. Artichoke hearts, salami, olives, marinated things.

item.title: Fried Egg on Toast with Hot Sauce
item.description: A perfectly fried egg with crispy lacy edges on buttered toast. Never gets old.

item.title: Mezze Plate
item.description: Hummus, tabbouleh, olives, pita. The Middle Eastern answer to the girl dinner snack plate.

item.title: Brie and Raspberry Quesadilla
item.description: Sweet savory quesadilla that sounds wrong but is absolutely right.

item.title: Ricotta Toast with Honey and Pistachios
item.description: Creamy, crunchy, sweet. The toast that makes breakfast for dinner feel indulgent.

item.title: Stovetop Popcorn Dinner
item.description: A bit unhinged but completely valid. Stovetop popcorn with real butter and fancy seasoning.

item.title: Caprese with Good Olive Oil
item.description: Three ingredients, zero cooking. Entirely dependent on quality. Get good tomatoes.

item.title: Instant Ramen Upgraded
item.description: Start with a 50 cent packet, finish with something that actually tastes good.

item.title: Pickles and Cheese Board
item.description: For when the jar of pickles IS the meal. Paired with aged cheese and crackers.

item.title: Soft Pretzel with Beer Cheese Dip
item.description: Warm soft pretzels and a quick melted cheese sauce. Salty, satisfying, no real effort.

item.title: Fruit and Yogurt Bowl with Honey and Granola
item.description: Breakfast as dinner is always valid. Greek yogurt, fruit, honey, crunch.

item.title: Loaded Baked Potato
item.description: A whole meal in a potato skin. Sour cream, cheese, chives, the works.

item.title: Greek Salad with Chickpeas
item.description: The most refreshing no cook dinner. Salty, crunchy, and genuinely satisfying.

item.title: Brie with Jam and Apple on a Board
item.description: Ripe brie, sharp jam, crisp apple slices. The girl dinner that feels like a French picnic.

item.title: Scrambled Eggs with Cream Cheese and Chives
item.description: Low and slow eggs with cream cheese folded in. The softest, richest scramble.

item.title: Butter Noodles with Parmesan and Black Pepper
item.description: Cacio e pepe's lazy cousin. Butter, parmesan, pepper, done in 10 minutes.

item.title: Charcuterie Snack Plate for One
item.description: All the hits of a charcuterie board scaled down to a solo dinner plate.

item.title: Grilled Cheese Dipped in Tomato Soup
item.description: The ultimate comfort duo. Golden buttery bread, melted cheese, silky soup for dunking.

item.title: Lazy Mac and Cheese
item.description: Kraft in a pot, made correctly. Extra butter, black pepper, and no apologies.

item.title: Hummus Plate with Warm Pita and Toppings
item.description: A good hummus plate hits different when the pita is warm and the toppings are thoughtful.

item.title: Avocado Toast with Everything Bagel and Chilli Flakes
item.description: Yes it is basic. Yes it is still perfect. The seasoning and chilli flakes make it.

item.title: Smoked Salmon Plate with Cream Cheese and Capers
item.description: Deli style but make it dinner. Everything a bagel would be without the bagel.

item.title: Burrata with Peach and Prosciutto
item.description: Sweet peach, salty prosciutto, creamy burrata. Summer on a plate with no cooking required.

item.title: Tinned Sardines on Buttered Toast
item.description: Briny, rich, and done in two minutes. The girl dinner for people with great taste.

item.title: Cottage Cheese and Everything Bagel Plate
item.description: Creamy cottage cheese, juicy tomatoes, and everything bagel seasoning make a savory plate with plenty of crunch.

item.title: Baked Feta Pasta
item.description: The TikTok pasta that broke the internet. Roasted tomatoes, melted feta, done.

item.title: Chilli Crisp Noodles with Soft-Boiled Egg
item.description: Six minute noodles that taste like you ordered them from a really good spot.

item.title: Whipped Feta with Hot Honey and Walnuts
item.description: Creamy, salty, sweet, and crunchy. Four textures in one bowl with zero cooking required.

item.title: The OG Girl Dinner
item.description: Bread, butter, sharp cheese, grapes, and pickles. The medieval peasant plate that started it all.
